import json, re, random, chess, sys
rules = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
def run(fen):
    for p, r in rules: fen = re.sub(p, r, fen)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]
def expected(b):
    s=set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion!=chess.QUEEN: continue
        c=b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
fen="<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(fen))
random.seed(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 0)
n=0; bad=0
for g in range(int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 300):
    b=chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply()<200:
        if b.turn==chess.WHITE:
            fen=b.fen(); ours=run(fen); exp=expected(b); n+=1
            okk = len(ours)==len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in exp for x in ours)
            if not okk:
                bad+=1
                if bad<5: print("FAIL",fen,set(ours)^exp)
        moves=list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward captures/promotions/castling
        pref=[m for m in moves if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(pref) if pref and random.random()<0.7 else random.choice(moves))
print(n,"positions",bad,"bad")
EOF
time python3 /tmp/test_re.py re.json 0 100
